content.comment_body: I purchased [article_no] ([product_name] logic module with display) and two expansion modules [article_no] ([product_name] expansion module, PS/I/O: 230V/230V/relay, 4 MW, 8 digital inputs/8 digital outputs). I need additional inputs/outputs and want to buy another [product_name] expansion module. Will it be supported and function properly? Secondly, for dimming lights, I need an expansion module such as 24 V DC, 2 analog outputs, 0-10 V. How can I connect this to my [product_name] 230V system?

Currently, you have a [product_name] [version_no]. A single [product_name] [version_no] supports: 24 digital inputs, 8 analog inputs, 20 digital outputs, and 8 analog outputs. If you require more IO, you must use a second [product_name] [version_no] along with a suitable number of expansion modules. By networking the [product_name] modules, you will have access to: 48 digital inputs, 16 analog inputs, 40 digital outputs, and 16 analog outputs.
For your second question, you need a 24 VDC power supply to connect to the analog output module, ensuring it works with your 230V system. You may find additional details here: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users request guidance on how many expansion modules can be added to the [product_name] logic module and how to integrate analog output modules for dimming control in a 230V-based system. There is some uncertainty about compatibility between modules and required power supplies. Responses provide input/output specifications and emphasize the importance of compatible power supplies, suggesting there is a need for better documentation and integration support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear guidance on how many expansion modules can be connected and easy-to-follow instructions for adding analog outputs that will work with a 230V setup.
